title: Explain a pipeline incident without hiding uncertainty

children.text: Tell an interviewer how you would explain a pipeline incident when the root cause is not yet confirmed.

items: Distinguish what is known from what is suspected.
Close with evidence, outcome and a prevention lesson when known.

children.text: Separate observed impact, verified facts and hypotheses. Explain your own action, the evidence used to test it and the next safe step. Use a real experience when practicing; do not invent employment history or outcomes.

children.title: Watch for this
children.text: Presenting an untested guess as the root cause, or claiming a team result as your own work, weakens the answer.

items: What would you tell stakeholders before you have a reliable recovery time?
Check how you handle uncertainty and tradeoffs.

children.text:
What pattern did I recognize, where did I get stuck, and what would I change in my first approach?

Use Context > Remarks for your personal reflection. It is saved separately from this reference.
